name: The Tale of Jane Eyre
source:
You arrive at Thornfield Manor tired, bruised and  anxious. Your aloof employer has described very little in her letters about the job itself, and all you are sure of  is that you are to be the governess of her young son.

This is the first time you have ever been on your own. Your tortured past haunts your every step, but you refuse to cower in the face of uncertainty. Headstrong and determined, you face your fate...

... no matter the cost...

[From [url=https://bunnidewabbit.itch.io/the-tale-of-jane-eyre]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你到达桑菲尔德庄园时，你疲惫不堪、伤痕累累，而且焦虑不安。你冷漠的雇主在信中很少描述这份工作本身，而你所确定的只是你将成为她小儿子的家庭教师。

这是你第一次独自一人。你痛苦的过去困扰着你的每一步，但面对不确定性，你拒绝退缩。任性而坚定，你面对你的命运……

……无论付出什么代价……

[来自[url=https://bunnidewabbit.itch.io/the-tale-of-jane-eyre]itch.io[/url]]
